description: The site's typeahead over everything TrackDIFF indexes: players (whole ladder, typo-tolerant; each with region, tier/division/LP, persona and whether they are in a game), personas (streamers/pros, with live status), champions (name and slug) and events. Use it to turn a half-remembered name into a Riot ID, persona slug, champion slug or event slug for the other tools. `resolveHint` is set when the query is already an exact "Name#TAG". `source: "fallback"` means the full-ladder index was unavailable and players are apex-only.

q.description: Free text: a player name, Riot ID, streamer, champion or event.

region.description: Bias player results to one platform.

name: search
title: Search TrackDIFF
